tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The connected Tookan account (admin user): user_id, email, name, company name and address. Good first call. POST /v2/get_user_details.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks (Tookan calls them jobs) of one task type within a date range of the task date (at most 31 days, within the last 31 days). Paginated: one Tookan page per call (page, default 1). Filter by status, agent (fleet_id), team, customer, job ids or your order ids. Task status codes: 0 assigned, 1

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: Full details of up to 100 tasks by job id: customer, addresses, agent (fleet_id/fleet_name), status, timestamps (started/arrived/completed), tracking link, custom fields; optionally the status history. Task status codes: 0 assigned, 1 started, 2 successful, 3 failed, 4 in progress/arrived, 6 unassig

tools.name: get_tasks_by_order_id
tools.description: Full details of the tasks carrying the given order ids (the reference you set when creating a task). POST /v2/get_job_details_by_order_id.

tools.name: get_task_stats
tools.description: Task counts per status (e.g. successful vs failed), optionally for one task type, one team and a date range. Task status codes: 0 assigned, 1 started, 2 successful, 3 failed, 4 in progress/arrived, 6 unassigned, 7 accepted/acknowledged, 8 declined, 9 cancelled, 10 deleted. POST /v2/user_task_stats.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents (drivers / field workers; Tookan calls them fleets) with fleet_id, name, phone, tags, team and live status (0 available, 1 offline, 2 busy). Filter by name, tags, availability or fleet ids. The API returns the whole list; this tool returns a window (limit/offset, next_offset). POST /v2/g

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: One agent's profile (name, email, phone, tags, transport, location, rating, active state) and current tasks. Only profile fields are returned; app tokens and password hashes never are. POST /v2/view_fleet_profile.

tools.name: get_agent_location
tools.description: An agent's last known coordinates (latitude/longitude). POST /v2/get_fleet_location.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List teams (team_id, name, address, tags). With include_agents, each team also lists its agents. Returns a window (limit/offset, next_offset). POST /v2/view_all_team_only (or /v2/view_teams with agents).

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List customers (customer_id, name, phone, email, address), optionally searched by name or phone. Paginated: one Tookan page per call (page, default 1). POST /v2/get_all_customers.

tools.name: find_customer_by_phone
tools.description: Find customers by exact phone number. POST /v2/find_customer_with_phone.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: One customer's profile (contact details, address, coordinates). POST /v2/view_customer_profile.

tools.name: create_delivery_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a delivery task (job) for a customer address, due by job_delivery_datetime in the given timezone. Optionally assign it to an agent (fleet_id) or team, or let Tookan auto-assign it within the team. Returns job_id and tracking link. Always uses the address given here, not one saved for t

tools.name: assign_agent_to_task
tools.description: WRITE: assign (or reassign) a task to an agent of a team; replaces any previous agent. Notifies the agent unless notify is false (so repeating the call notifies again). POST /v2/assign_fleet_to_task.

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description: WRITE (DESTRUCTIVE): force a task's status, overriding the agent app. Completing (2 successful, 3 failed) or cancelling (9) closes the task and notifies per the account's settings; confirm with the user first. Deleting (10) is not offered. Settable: 0 assigned, 1 started, 2 successful, 3 failed, 4 a

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_agent" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account, list_tasks, get_tasks, get_tasks_by_order_id, get_task_stats, list_agents, get_agent, get_agent_location, list_teams, list_customers, get_customer · Private data: get_agent, get_customer · Public sink: get_account, list_tasks, get_tasks, get_tasks_by_order_id, get_task_stats, list_agents, get_agent, get_agent_location, list_teams, list_customers, find_customer_by_phone, get_customer, create_delivery_task, assign_agent_to_task, update_task_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, list_tasks, get_tasks, get_tasks_by_order_id, get_task_stats, list_agents, get_agent, get_agent_location, list_teams, list_customers, get_customer · Private data: get_agent, get_customer · Public sink: get_account, list_tasks, get_tasks, get_tasks_by_order_id, get_task_stats, list_agents, get_agent, get_agent_location, list_teams, list_customers, find_customer_by_phone, get_customer, create_delivery_task, assign_agent_to_task, update_task_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
